consumer.mode: isolated worktree, existing private remote, bounded governance/doc-only acceptance; no infra or personal data

design: Extract request-only PRE validation reused by native PRE and machine builder; never create reviewer PASS.

Build Work Unit candidate from predecessor and explicit semantic decision, bind CONTROL/STATE, check current schema/scope; canonical bytes/hashes computed after generation; no implementation authorization.
Build Finding Result and FIX Instruction with current schemas and explicit accepted adjudication; no automatic adjudication.

Restricted management entry requires existing WU/Instruction/native PRE, one PRE plus independent POST for bounded metadata bundle, no successor cleanup branch/WU; source changes, refs deletion and authority drift denied.
Risk-tiered recommendation preserves focused safety/affected validators plus real reproduction; full suite once for release; no cached authority reuse.
Single compact human handoff includes immutable locator, identity/role/scope and stop conditions; implementer proof cannot replace independent reviewer.
review_focus: Candidate WU does not authorize or broaden scope
Management denies source changes, stale identity/revision or remote drift
Finding needs explicit durable adjudication plus fresh FIX context
Released Consumer behavior must match actual remote observed facts
scope_expansion_rule: real user-path blocker, authority/fail-closed break, or compounding debt only
subject: ISSUE17_STAGE1_SCOPE_AND_PLAN

tasks.validation: minimal new behavior/stale/scope tests and affected envelope/lifecycle validators
real Consumer management and real Finding remediation; old flow, core fail-closed/conflict checks
one release full suite, clean artifact, remote tag/release/assets verification
